description:
## Status

Absorbed into `fz-kdt.64` and the corrected `fz-tfn` source-publication chain. The recursive retraction defect is real, but this ticket's former scheduler-metadata-only source model is false.

Exact job read/output ownership records invalidation and claim ownership. It does not record which independently justified parts of an aggregate a read supports. A surviving key path cannot distinguish:

```text
A = seed union B
B = A
```

after `seed` changes `{x, y}` to `{y}`: every key and an external ground remain present while stale `x` must disappear. A producer that also owns a local constant can present the same read/output transcript while legitimately retaining `x`, so the scheduler cannot infer the answer.

## Current ownership of the valid laws

- `fz-tfn.61` owns stable typed source owner/version identity.
- `fz-tfn.53` owns validated typed publication without mutation-before-error.
- `fz-tfn.46` owns completed Blocked/Failed attempts and their exact observations.
- `fz-kdt.82` carries changed-withdrawal direction as a typed ground shift.
- `fz-kdt.64` owns the bounded real `ReturnType`/`ActivationInputs` consumer model in which cyclic copies are not new ground.
- `fz-tfn.57` exposes replacement only after those boundaries exist.
- `fz-kdt.200` owns the final InputDemand consumer, its source-owned semantic-question/binding algebra, and deletion of its private cone.

The existing World typed stores remain the value authorities. Producers preserve content-specific support before joins erase it; the scheduler routes authoritative movements and never treats reachability, finality, a source-body read, or ProductMemo retention as semantic support. `LoweredBody` remains the sole operation/value/control denotation.

No standalone implementation of the old plan is to land. Its self/mutual-cycle, seed remove/replace, independent/shared support, forwarding-edge removal, typed-store reappearance, scheduling-order, wake-cause, and zero-work laws are explicit acceptance criteria of `fz-kdt.64`; failed-attempt laws are in `fz-tfn.46`; live-replacement laws are in `fz-tfn.57`; InputDemand cost laws are in `fz-kdt.200`.

The synthetic scheduler witness proved the information deficit but was removed after recutting; it is not a production regression and must not be restored as evidence that generic scheduler reachability can solve semantic support.

comments.text: fz-kdt.199 landed (dd07432db) and its build/2 gate names this ticket as its removal owner, so the split is recorded as a PIN rather than blessed as a law. Measured at the landing: of the executables 199 adds, 36 buy a distinct return and 91 do not (83 on the cold review's 597-fixture comparand). Top offenders: List.reduce_cont/3 (21), List.reduce_while_cont/3 (18), Range.reduce_while_cont/6 (9), reduce_while_step/3 (6) -- all the mutual reduce cycle the self-only subtraction cannot see. Red-first for you: those fall while the 36 bought ones and every ONE_ACTIVATION_KEYING_LAWS row hold, and quicksort stays at 17.
